This is the LAST live G1 leg — the three-project Review matrix + instrumented cost runs, then a rewrite of
`docs/phase0-exit-readout.md` and the flag that G1 is ready to disposition. It is **mostly a live-execution
ticket → [OPERATOR GATE]d** (real infra + paid inference), so it splits into Stage A (offline construction,
this PR) and Stage B (the operator-gated live drive).

**Stage B was NOT run this session** — there was no operator authorization, no stated spend budget, and no
confirmed deployed `dev`, and it additionally depends on **16_P0.15j**'s own live AC3 (a Review must DELIVER
`cited⇒fetched`-green first, still a RETURN PASS). Per the ticket banner + BM-DEFER-02, the gate is surfaced,
not guessed past, and no live pass is fabricated. AC1/AC2(live)/AC3 are **gate-pending** and carried in RETURN
PASS.

Stage A did the constructable, no-spend half: prepared the **multi-project fixtures** and **wired the one
genuinely-missing call-site** (the instrumented fold), so Stage B is a plain budgeted re-run.

## What changed

- **Multi-project fixture (AC1).** `integration/src/live-prepare-fixture.ts` now repoints **all three** real
  drafts — `proj_pv` / `proj_sd` / `proj_cr` — to genuine ~800–900-word prose (was `proj_pv`-only). The seed
  writes each `<proj>_av1` head with a placeholder sha + no GCS bytes, so `/work` materialization would dangle
  for the other two; the fixup uploads real bytes + repoints each (funding `bill_seed` unchanged). The new
  `proj_sd` / `proj_cr` drafts are written to match their seeded findings (the "market-leaning"/currency
  characterizations; the overreaching Kaesberg gloss).
- **The instrumented-fold call-site (AC2 / D-P0.15-2), previously missing.** `foldInstrumentedRun` is pure and
  was never applied in the live path, and `estimatorsAreProvisional()` read a hardcoded const — so nothing could
  ever flip it and AC2 could not pass even on a perfect live run. Fixed:
  - `packages/protocols/src/estimator.ts` — an **instrumented-override registry**: `recordInstrumentedFold`
    (folds into the workflow's current spec + records it), `estimatorSpec` (override-first read-through),
    `estimatorsAreProvisional()` reads override-first, `resetInstrumentedOverrides()`. `foldInstrumentedRun`
    stays pure and unchanged.
  - `integration/src/live-exit-driver.ts` — the driver **folds each instrumented run** through an injectable
    `InstrumentedFolder` seam and surfaces the folds (`estimatorFolds`); a `null` fold (unmetered run) records
    nothing (never fabricated).
  - `integration/src/instrumented-folder.ts` — the live binding `createDbInstrumentedFolder`: reads the run's
    measured proxy cost (`proxyVsSdkCrossCheck`, the meter of record) → `platformCredits` (§14.1) + the run's
    estimator inputs, and records the fold. The pure mapping (`buildInstrumentedMeasurement`) is unit-tested.
  - `integration/src/run-live-exit.ts` — wires `foldInstrumented: createDbInstrumentedFolder()`, plus
    `draftIdFor` (each project reviews its seeded `<proj>_d1`) and `second_read=false` review runs (the G1
    delivery mode, D-P0.15h-5).
- **Design record — ADR-005** (`docs/adr/ADR-005-instrumented-fold-registry.md`): why the fold is recorded in a
  process-local override (adequate for the exit assertion; the durable price-card persistence is the follow-up).
- **Exit readout (AC4, partial).** `docs/phase0-exit-readout.md` — corrected the stale top status banner to the
  true current state (full pipeline proven P0.15g/h/i; two live legs remain) and appended a **P0.15k Stage A**
  section: the offline construction + the exact remaining live checklist. The MEASURED-value rewrite of the
  criterion table + the "G1 ready" flag are **gate-pending** (they need Stage B), and this is reported honestly
  rather than asserted.
- **DEFERRALS** — D-P0.15-1 / D-P0.15-2 advanced with Stage-A notes (kept OPEN); D-P0.15-3 marked the AC3 gate.

## Design decisions

- The fold is recorded in a **process-local** registry, not persisted to a DB, because the AC (and §16.4
  price-card precondition) only needs `estimatorsAreProvisional()` to reflect the fold in the one driver process
  that runs the metered runs; durable persistence (a `estimator_specs` table / folding the measured constants
  into the shipped source) is a larger, out-of-scope follow-up. See ADR-005 for the tradeoff + revisit trigger.
- The live folder reads the measured cost from the **proxy** (the meter of record), never the SDK figure; a run
  with no proxy cost yet folds **nothing** (`null`) rather than a fabricated zero.
